roadmap.goal: Let anyone who can read a Then & Now report export it as a light, branded, dated PDF, from the report view's Export PDF button or the Reports list's PDF icon, through a chrome-less print page that reads the report afresh and opens the print dialog exactly once; make that PDF read the same on every machine (drawn marks, Quicksand bundled with the app, nothing cut in two on paper) and explain itself to a cold reader; then let assistants and the lh command line read reports through four read-only MCP tools and lh report list|get, and show a Then & Now as a faithful dashboard through the lighthouse-reports skill.

steps.name: The print page's state is a pure function of its four inputs: preparing, ready, failed and retryable, failed for a part, or failed for good
steps.scenario_name: decides the state when %s (16-row table: ready; an answer as old as the mount; none; only an older one; owner, terms, fonts pending; a font failed -> failedPart; a refused or failed read with an answer held -> failedRetryable; owner or terms unreadable -> failedPart; a failed read and a failed font -> failedRetryable; 404 / 422 win; 404 with a font failure); is ready exactly when all four inputs are in, and preparing otherwise (32-combination grid); active guard: the module imports nothing from React, the router or the query library

Any other report error, or a non-ApiError, gives failedRetryable, even when a font failed too
With no report error, an owner-read error, a terms error or fonts = failed gives failedPart
Otherwise the state is ready exactly when fetchedAt >= mountedAt, the owner's name is present, the terms have answered and fonts = loaded, and preparing in every other combination of the 32
steps.implementation_notes: ~1h. A pure function, so the exhaustive table is the property. Read the error through services/Api/ApiError.ts's code, as ReportView does. steps.name: The print-once hook uses up the wish to print before printing, and prints once only when the page is ready and the wish is there
steps.scenario_name: clears the wish to print from the page's entry, keeping where it started, then prints once; never prints, nor touches the history, while the page is %s (x4: preparing, failedRetryable, failedPart, failedFinal); never prints a page that carries no wish to print; prints once under React's strict mode, which runs the effect twice; prints no more when the page draws again before the cleared entry reaches it; prints once when a failed page becomes ready after Retry
criteria: When the state is ready and the wish is present, the hook first replaces the current entry with the same path and { from } without the wish, and then calls the port's print exactly once, in that order
In any state other than ready, or without the wish, it neither prints nor touches history
A per-mount record keeps StrictMode's second effect run and a redraw before the cleared entry arrives from printing again
A page that failed and becomes ready after Retry prints once (PD-1)
steps.implementation_notes: ~1.5h. The hook takes the page state, the wish, the origin and the PrintEffectPort as parameters and reads nothing else (no useLocation inside). The wish is used up only by an actual print, so a reload while still preparing, or a failure before Retry, still prints once when the page becomes ready (DDD-26). aMomentLater lets five microtask turns pass; add no timer here, or the negatives must move to fake timers (Known gap 13).
